# Step - next

`next` · category: [Running and showing results](../../traversal/step_reference.md#running-and-showing-results)

Runs the traversal and returns its first result (unit when there is none).

## Forms

```text
next()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().values("name").next()   // marko
```
